quote: Access to the $GLOBALS array is now subject to a number of restrictions.
reason: Assigning, compound-assigning, appending to, referencing, unsetting, incrementing, destructuring into (list() or [ ]) or using as a foreach target $GLOBALS as a whole is a compile error from 8.1 and passing it to a by-reference parameter of an internal function throws an Error, all visible in the source; foreach by reference over $GLOBALS still runs on 8.1 and is not reported, and writing to a copy of $GLOBALS (which changed the globals before 8.1) depends on later use of the copy (runtime.globals_copy_write).

quote: Passing null to a non-nullable argument of a built-in function is deprecated.
reason: A literal null passed to a scalar parameter of a global internal function that no runtime from 8.1 to 8.5 declares nullable (table from Reflection) is reported, except under strict_types where it was always a TypeError; null held in a variable, the usual case, and method calls are runtime-only (runtime.null_to_internal_scalar_variable).

quote: When a method using static variables is inherited (but not overridden), the inherited method will now share static variables with the parent method.
reason: The class structure is visible, but the output only differs when the inherited method is called through both the parent and the child (or two children) at run time, which the syntax tree cannot tell.

quote: Most non-final internal methods now require overriding methods to declare a compatible return type, otherwise a deprecated notice is emitted during inheritance validation.
reason: A method without a return type and without #[ReturnTypeWillChange], declared in a class or interface that names the internal class or interface itself, overriding a method that has a tentative return type on every runtime from 8.1 to 8.5 (Reflection), is reported with a verified fix that adds the attribute; incompatible declared types, trait methods and internal types reached through user classes are not judged.

quote: The fileinfo functions now accept and return, respectively, finfo objects instead of resources.
reason: is_resource() of a finfo_open() call (with or without @), or of a local variable whose only writes in its function are finfo_open() results, is false from 8.1 and is reported with a verified fix to ( false !== ... ); handles kept in properties or top-level variables are not followed (runtime.is_resource_finfo_elsewhere).

quote: The FTP functions now accept and return, respectively, FTP\Connection objects instead of resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the ftp extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: The IMAP functions now accept and return, respectively, IMAP\Connection objects instead of resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the imap extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: The LDAP functions now accept and return, respectively, LDAP\Connection objects instead of "ldap link" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the ldap extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: The LDAP functions now accept and return, respectively, LDAP\Result objects instead of "ldap result" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the ldap extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: The LDAP functions now accept and return, respectively, LDAP\ResultEntry objects instead of "ldap result entry" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the ldap extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: mysqli_fetch_fields() and mysqli_fetch_field_direct() will now always return zero for max_length.
reason: max_length is data returned by the server: it only shows with result sets from a MySQL server, which no runtime here can reach, so no fixture can demonstrate it and the source does not tell the values.

quote: The MYSQLI_STMT_ATTR_UPDATE_MAX_LENGTH option no longer has an effect.
reason: The constant still exists on every runtime (checked) and code passing it looks the same as before; its lost effect on max_length it only shows with result sets from a MySQL server, which no runtime here can reach, so no fixture can demonstrate it and the source does not tell the values.

quote: The MYSQLI_STORE_RESULT_COPY_DATA option no longer has an effect.
reason: The constant still exists on every runtime (checked) and code passing it looks the same as before; its lost effect it only shows with result sets from a MySQL server, which no runtime here can reach, so no fixture can demonstrate it and the source does not tell the values.

quote: The default error handling mode has been changed from "silent" to "exceptions".
reason: mysqli_driver::$report_mode defaults to 3 (MYSQLI_REPORT_ERROR | MYSQLI_REPORT_STRICT) from 8.1 instead of 0, verified without a server; whether a given query or connection fails is a run-time matter, and mysqli_report() may be called in another file.

quote: Classes extending mysqli_stmt::execute() will be required to specify the additional parameter now.
reason: A class extending mysqli_stmt that declares execute() with no parameters is a fatal error at declaration from 8.1; an override with a required parameter was already fatal on 8.0 and is not part of this change.

quote: mysqli::connect() will now return true instead of null on success.
reason: The return value only exists after a successful connection to a MySQL server, which no runtime here can reach, and code that tests it cannot be told from code that does not care.

quote: The mysqlnd.fetch_data_copy ini setting has been removed.
reason: An INI setting of mysqlnd; the notes say it has no user-visible effect.

quote: EC private keys will now be exported in PKCS#8 format rather than traditional format, just like all other keys.
reason: Whether an exported key is an EC key depends on the key, a run-time value; verified that openssl_pkey_export() of an EC key writes BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY before 8.1 and BEGIN PRIVATE KEY (PKCS#8) from 8.1.

quote: openssl_pkcs7_encrypt() and openssl_cms_encrypt() will now default to using AES-128-CBC rather than RC2-40.
reason: openssl_pkcs7_encrypt() without the $cipher_algo argument is visible and was verified to switch from RC2 to AES-128-CBC; openssl_cms_encrypt() only exists from 8.0, so no fixture can show its 7.4 behaviour and it is not reported.

quote: PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES now also stringifies values of type bool to "0" or "1".
reason: No driver available to the runtimes returns booleans (SQLite has no boolean type; MySQL needs a server), so it cannot be demonstrated, and the attribute may be set anywhere at run time.

quote: Calling bindColumn() with PDO::PARAM_LOB (and assuming stringification is not enabled) will now consistently bind a stream result, as documented.
reason: Verified with SQLite (a string before 8.1, a stream from 8.1), but the result depended on the driver before, so a bindColumn() call with PDO::PARAM_LOB does not tell whether anything changes for the database in use.

quote: Integers and floats in result sets will now be returned using native PHP types instead of strings when using emulated prepared statements.
reason: Needs a MySQL server, which no runtime here can reach, and whether a statement is emulated is set at run time; the same change for SQLite is shown by runtime.pdo_sqlite_native_types.

quote: Integers and floats in results sets will now be returned using native PHP types.
reason: Which connection is SQLite and what a query returns are run-time values; verified that SELECT 1, 1.5 gives strings before 8.1 and int and float from 8.1, and that PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES gives strings on every version.

quote: The PgSQL functions now accept and return, respectively, \PgSql\Connection objects instead of "pgsql link" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the pgsql extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: The PgSQL functions now accept and return, respectively, \PgSql\Result objects instead of "pgsql result" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the pgsql extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: The PgSQL functions now accept and return, respectively, \PgSql\Lob objects instead of "pgsql large object" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the pgsql extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: To comply with the ArrayAccess interface, Phar::offsetUnset() and PharData::offsetUnset() no longer return a boolean.
reason: Verified that PharData::offsetUnset() returns true before 8.1 and null from 8.1, but a call named offsetUnset() can be on any ArrayAccess object; an override in a class extending Phar or PharData is covered by signature.tentative_return_type_missing.

quote: The PSpell functions now accept and return, respectively, PSpell\Dictionary objects instead of "pspell" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the pspell extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: The PSpell functions now accept and return, respectively, PSpell\Config objects instead of "pspell config" resources.
reason: None of the runtimes (php-wasm 7.4 to 8.5) has the pspell extension, so nothing can be shown or verified.

quote: version_compare() no longer accepts undocumented operator abbreviations.
reason: A literal operator 'l', 'g', 'e' or 'n' throws a ValueError from 8.1 and has a verified fix to the full spelling; the runtime showed that an empty operator also throws from 8.1, while upper-case spellings were already refused on 8.0, so those are not part of this change.

quote: htmlspecialchars(), htmlentities(), htmlspecialchars_decode(), html_entity_decode() and get_html_translation_table() now use ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE rather than ENT_COMPAT by default.
reason: Calls without $flags are reported only where the result is sure to change: a string literal with ' to htmlspecialchars()/htmlentities(), one with ' or ' to the decode functions, and get_html_translation_table(); text in variables, and malformed UTF-8, are runtime-only (runtime.html_default_flags_variable, runtime.html_malformed_utf8).

quote: debug_zval_dump() will now print reference wrappers with their refcount, instead of only prepending a "&" to the value.
reason: A debugging aid whose output depends on whether a value is a reference at run time; verified &int(1) before 8.1 and reference refcount(2) { int(1) } from 8.1.

quote: debug_zval_dump() will now print "interned" instead of a dummy refcount of one for interned strings and immutable arrays.
reason: A debugging aid whose output depends on whether a string or array is interned at run time; verified refcount(1) before 8.1 and interned from 8.1 for a string literal.

quote: SplFixedArray will now be JSON encoded like an array.
reason: Verified {"0":"a","1":"b"} before 8.1 and ["a","b"] from 8.1, but json_encode() is usually given a variable whose class is known only at run time.
